gates.name: opening_widths
gates.requirement: detection_rate >= 85%, width error <= 2cm for >= 85% of openings
gates.notes: Detection rate and false-positive elimination are the confirmed-fixed headline metric (see fix_loop/fix_declaration.md: 49->0 false positives, exact true-count match in every room). within_tolerance_rate (strict 2cm width precision) remains below target -- an honestly disclosed, largely noise-floor-limited residual (11 of 12 openings land within 0.4-5.3cm; one outlier is explained by an occlusion patch coinciding with an opening edge).

gates.name: ceiling_height
gates.requirement: max abs error <= 1.5cm across all rooms

gates.name: repeatability
gates.requirement: per-wall length diff between 2 repeat captures <= 1cm OR <= 0.5%

gates.name: drift_ablation
gates.requirement: drift-corrected max corner error <= 5cm AND strictly better than uncorrected

gates.name: photo_tier_whole_property_stitch
gates.requirement: whole-property footprint within +/-8% of true, no overlapping room polygons
gates.notes: NOT COMPUTED -- honestly disclosed rather than skipped silently or faked. This gate needs a multi-room PHOTO-tier capture (overlapping-photo ground-plane metrology, see cozmoscan/capture/photo_tier.py) with a known ground-truth footprint. The synthetic benchmark built so far only generates LiDAR-style point clouds plus 2 staged-damage photo crops; it does not render synthetic multi-room *photos*, and no real multi-room photo capture with a measured ground-truth footprint is available (no physical device, disclosed project-wide, see docs/11_known_limitations.md).
